title: Atzlk MC: Official Modpack
description: Official Modrinth Modpack for Atzlk MC Weather SMP
body:
# Official Modpack for Atzlk MC / mc.atzlk.com
This modpack contains all the required and recommended mods for playing on mc.atzlk.com, a minecraft server w/ Weather2 & addons which adds tornadoes, hurricanes, storms and more to the game!

Weather: Tornadoes, Storms, Cyclones, Firenadoes, Landspouts & more!

Main featured mods in this Modpack: Weather Storms & Tornadoes, Expanded Weather2 Dynamics, Farmers Delight, The Roads More Travelled, Simple Voice Chat, JEI, Mouse Tweaks, Distant Horizions & Optimization Tweaks
